voiceProfiles.description: All vocabulary, Ana’s dialogue, and narrator lines.
Shopkeeper and Mrvica (cat) lines — always the same voice.

clips.english: Good day! Yes? / Can I help you?
clips.speaker: Shopkeeper

clips.english: Yes. Tea. Here you are! / Please!
clips.speaker: Shopkeeper

clips.english: my name is / I am called

clips.bosnian: Da! Ja sam Ana. Zovem se Ana.
clips.english: Yes! I am Ana. My name is Ana.
clips.speaker: Ana

clips.bosnian: Drago mi je! Ja sam Emir.
clips.english: Nice to meet you! I am Emir.
clips.speaker: Emir

clips.bosnian: Drago mi je, Emir. Ti si iz Sarajeva?
clips.english: Nice to meet you, Emir. Are you from Sarajevo?
clips.speaker: Ana

clips.bosnian: Da. Ja sam iz Sarajeva. On (Sebilj) je tu.
clips.english: Yes. I am from Sarajevo. That (Sebilj) is here.
clips.speaker: Emir

clips.english: Thank you! Are you a guide?
clips.speaker: Ana

clips.english: Yes, I am a guide. Let’s go!
clips.speaker: Emir

clips.english: Good day! Yes? / What can I get you?
clips.speaker: Amira

clips.bosnian: I ja. jednu kahvu. Dva fildžana.
clips.english: And me. one coffee. Two cups.
clips.speaker: Emir

clips.english: Good. How many lokum? One? Two?
clips.speaker: Amira

clips.english: You’re welcome! The coffee is here.
clips.speaker: Amira

clips.english: Mrvica jumps up. Ana: Hello, Mrvica!
clips.speaker: Narrator

clips.bosnian: Moja majka je u Americi. Moj otac je u Americi.
clips.english: My mother is in America. My father is in America.
clips.speaker: Ana

clips.bosnian: Moja sestra je u Americi. Brat? Ne.
clips.english: My sister is in America. Brother? No.
clips.speaker: Ana

clips.english: Good. We are a little family!
clips.speaker: Amira

clips.bosnian: Emir je moj prijatelj. Ti si moja prijateljica.
clips.english: Emir is my friend. You are my friend.
clips.speaker: Ana

clips.english: Mrvica jumps up. Ana: Hello, Mrvica!
clips.speaker: Narrator

clips.bosnian: Da! Mostar je tamo. Stari most, rijeka Neretva…
clips.english: Yes! Mostar is there. The Old Bridge, the Neretva river…
clips.speaker: Emir

clips.bosnian: Da. Sutra u deset sati ovdje. Poslije Travnik? Una?
clips.english: Yes. Tomorrow at ten o’clock here. Later Travnik? The Una?
clips.speaker: Emir

clips.bosnian: Dobro. Jutro za kahvu. Subota za rijeku!
clips.english: Good. Morning for coffee. Saturday for the river!
clips.speaker: Amira

clips.bosnian: Ovo je moja sedmica. Foto: kahva kod Amire!
clips.english: This is my week. Photo: coffee at Amira’s!
clips.speaker: Ana

clips.english: Bravo. And this? Jajce, a waterfall!
clips.speaker: Emir

clips.english: And Blagaj? The tekke on the Buna.
clips.speaker: Amira

clips.bosnian: Da! Počitelj, stari grad. Sutra na mapi!
clips.english: Yes! Počitelj, an old town. Tomorrow on the map!
clips.speaker: Emir

clips.english: Bravo, Ana. The week is done!
clips.speaker: Amira
